text:
Dark mode is live for everyone as of May 12, and we hope it's easier on your eyes. 🌙

You asked for it, and we listened. Nearly 40% of our beta testers requested dark mode, so we built it, and it's now available to 100% of users.

We did more than invert the colors. Body text has a contrast ratio of 7:1, which exceeds the WCAG AAA standard, so your notes stay easy to read whether you're writing at midnight or drafting in a sunlit café.

What you get:

🌑 **Easy on the eyes**: Less glare during late-night brainstorming
🎨 **Crisp, clean text**: High contrast keeps every word sharp
⚡ **Quick switching**: Toggle between light and dark with one tap

To try it, go to Settings and pick your mode. 💡

Thanks for helping us get this right. Keep the notes coming!
